fields.title: 2026-10-14 · Spruce Robotics · First meeting
fields.attendees: Lin Xiao; Zhang Yifan, Spruce founder & CEO (fictional)
fields.summary:
- The founding team comes from industrial automation and has built flexible assembly for four years.
- Product: robot-arm workstations plus line-scheduling software, subscribed per workstation per month.
- Customers today are mostly auto-parts and electronics assembly plants in the Yangtze River Delta.
fields.highlights:
- Small factories accept a subscription more readily than expected.
- Delivery depends on field engineers; scale is the open question.
fields.questions:
- How much delivery effort does each workstation really take?
- Will customers renew?

fields.title: 2026-10-28 · Spruce Robotics · Follow-up meeting
fields.attendees: Lin Xiao, Wang Liheng; Zhang Yifan (fictional)
fields.summary:
- A partner joined for the product demo and the delivery walkthrough.
- The new scheduling software moves deployment from on-site tuning to mostly remote configuration.
- Both sides agreed to start due diligence.
fields.highlights:
- Remote configuration cuts delivery effort sharply (founder's account).
- The partner's concern: stability of the core algorithm team.
fields.questions:
- Delivery time needs checking with customers.
- Has the head of algorithms signed a long-term agreement?

fields.title: 2026-11-03 · Clearview Data · First meeting
fields.attendees: Zhou Ke; Xu Ning, Clearview CEO (fictional)
fields.summary:
- The product turns data from ERP, CRM and documents into one catalog that agents query.
- Three pilot customers, one a brokerage.
- Plans to raise a Pre-A round before year end.
fields.highlights:
- Lands exactly on "every employee has an agent, but the data is not shared".
- Permissions stop at the table level; financial customers will ask about that.
fields.questions:
- What does a private deployment cost to deliver?
- How is it different from the big platforms' data products?

fields.title: 2026-10-21 · Wavecraft Health · Diligence interview
fields.attendees: Chen Siyuan; heads of radiology at two partner hospitals (fictional)
fields.summary:
- Interviewed radiology at two county hospitals: reading volume is high and the software is used mainly as a first-pass prompt.
- Doctors value fewer misses but complain about false positives.
fields.highlights:
- Doctors will keep using it if false positives keep falling.
- Purchasing is led by the hospital IT department; decisions take long.
fields.questions: - What is the plan for false positives in the next algorithm version?

fields.title: 2026-11-04 · Wavecraft Health · IC meeting
fields.attendees: Wang Liheng, Chen Siyuan and the investment committee
fields.summary:
- The investment committee met and the deal team presented its diligence findings.
- The conclusion and the partners' view are recorded in "IC notes (leadership only)", not here.

fields.title: 2026-10-09 · Perch Coffee · First meeting
fields.summary:
- Neighbourhood specialty coffee with its own roastery.
- Plans to grow quickly through franchising.
fields.highlights: - Strong product reputation; repeat visits come from regulars in the neighbourhood.
fields.questions: - How is quality kept under franchising?

fields.title: 2026-10-30 · Perch Coffee · Follow-up meeting
fields.attendees: He Jia, Wang Liheng; Perch founder (fictional)
fields.summary:
- Went through the franchise plan in detail.
- Internal view: growth depends on franchising, which does not fit our consumer thesis.
fields.highlights: - Decided to decline politely and revisit in six months.

fields.title: 2026-09-25 · Starplan Software · Portfolio review
fields.summary:
- Quarterly review: product roadmap, hiring and the channel plan.
- A CTO candidate is in final interviews.
fields.highlights: - Hiring is the biggest bottleneck right now.

fields.title: 2026-11-04 · Starplan Software · Portfolio review
fields.attendees: Wang Liheng, He Jia; Starplan CEO and CTO (fictional)
fields.summary:
- The new CTO has started and walked through a first technical roadmap.
- Next quarter's focus is channel partnerships; they would like introductions from us.
fields.highlights:
- CTO in place; the hiring bottleneck is cleared.
- Channel partnerships need our introductions.
fields.questions: - The roadmap has no milestones yet.

fields.title: 2026-11-04 · Starplan Software · Board pack filed
fields.summary:
- Filed this quarter's board pack (no file attached in the sample).
- New since September: the CTO hire and the channel plan.
fields.highlights: - Operating figures in the pack were not copied into the shared tables (the rule is to keep the original only).

fields.title: 2026-11-02 · Polaris Compute · Pitch deck received
fields.summary:
- Received the Polaris Compute deck (no file attached in the sample) through a friend's referral.
- Inference cluster scheduling for small model teams.
fields.highlights: - Same AI-infrastructure theme as Clearview Data; worth looking at together.
fields.questions: - Team background still to be checked.
